results.question: With no true change, how often does model selection pick a model of change?
results.design: 8 weekly sessions × 3 repetitions, σε = 4, σs = 2.5, true performance constant

results.question: How large must a weekly change be before it is detected in 8 weekly sessions?
results.design: 8 weekly sessions × 3 repetitions, σε = 4, σs = 2.5, true linear change of 0.5–3 units/week
results.criterion: power ≥ 0.8 at 2 units/week (≈ 14 units over the series)

results.question: Do 95 % profile-likelihood intervals for the weekly slope cover the true slope ~95 % of the time?
results.design: 10 weekly sessions × 3 repetitions, true slope 1.5 units/week
results.criterion: coverage in [0.88, 0.99] (small-sample likelihood intervals are known to be slightly liberal)

results.question: Can a slow learning-curve time constant (τ = 60 d) be estimated from 8 weekly sessions, 24 sessions every 4 days, or 16 weekly sessions?
results.design: Exponential approach 90 → 150 units; σε = 4, σs = 2.5, 3 repetitions
results.criterion: 16 weekly sessions identifiable more often than 8 weekly sessions

results.question: With 10 sessions, do the data favour forgetting (learning–retention) over saturation (exponential) when forgetting is true?
results.design: Truth: learning–retention, h = 21 d, gain 0.3 units/min; regular weekly 40 min vs 4- and 6-week breaks with 20–60 min doses
results.criterion: ΔAICc > 2 in favour of learning–retention in ≥ 50 % of seeds with breaks, ≤ 20 % with the regular schedule

results.question: Are fast/slow learning rates recoverable from assessment-like sparse data, or only from dense error-driven trials?
results.design: Smith 2006 paradigm (235 trials: baseline, adaptation, reversal, error clamp); A_f 0.92, A_s 0.996, B_f 0.10, B_s 0.02, σ 0.08
results.criterion: dense observation identifies all four rates more often than 10 sparse observations

results.question: Do 95 % intervals for the NEXT session mean contain it ~95 % of the time (plug-in vs bootstrap)?
results.design: True linear change 1.5/week; fit on 10 weekly sessions; predict an 11th session one week later; B = 150

results.question: How do more sessions or more repetitions per session change the power to detect 2 units/week?
results.design: True linear change 2 units/week, σε = 4, σs = 2.5; weekly sessions
